title: Training Note: Early Payoff and Moving Payment Arrangement Plans Between Agreements
content:
# Training Note: Early Payoff and Moving Payment Arrangement Plans Between Agreements

Two plan features vary by kind of Payment Arrangement: whether the customer may pay the remaining plan balance at any time to complete the plan, and whether the plan moves with the customer to a new service agreement when the current one closes.

| Arrangement kind | Early payoff at any time | Plan moves to the customer's new service agreement |
|---|---|---|
| Payment Extension | Yes | No |
| Short-Term Installment Plan | Yes | Yes |
| Standard Deferred Payment Agreement | Yes | Yes |
| Extended Deferred Payment Agreement | Yes | Yes |
| Winter Protection Plan | Yes | Yes |
| Arrearage Management Program | Yes | No |
| Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement | Yes | No |

## Questions this note answers

**Can a customer on any kind of plan pay it off early?**
Yes. Every kind allows the customer to pay the remaining plan balance at any time to complete the plan.

**Which kinds can follow the customer to a new address?**
The Short-Term Installment Plan, the Standard Deferred Payment Agreement, the Extended Deferred Payment Agreement and the Winter Protection Plan. The Payment Extension, the Arrearage Management Program and the Commercial Deferred Payment Agreement do not move with the customer.
